text: The deletion succeeded. The protection contract did not. EqualTrace finds the gap a final-state test would miss.
One seed. One domain engine. The visual and assistive routes preserve all six protections. Native Web M C P reaches the same outcome with only two.
The first break is concrete. The agent commits before consequences are disclosed. EqualTrace stops there and links the failure to recorded runtime evidence.
The agent can stage one exact repair. It cannot approve it. A person reviews the action, consequence, seed, digest, and expiry. Before that approval, the repair tool is absent.
Approval changes the native tool surface. Four tools become five. The bound repair runs once. Immediately, the surface returns to four and replay is blocked.
EqualTrace clears the old traces and reruns all three routes. Six protections now survive every path. Five consecutive native runs produce the same deterministic receipt.
EqualTrace. Runtime protection parity for the agentic web. Five native runs. One receipt.
